title: Classic French Omelette
description: A silky, perfectly rolled French omelette with fine herbs and butter. The hallmark of classic technique.
ingredients: Salt and white pepper to taste
steps: Crack eggs into a bowl and whisk vigorously until fully combined and slightly frothy — about 30 seconds.
Stir in the chopped herbs, salt, and white pepper.
Heat an 8-inch nonstick skillet over medium heat and add the butter, swirling to coat.
When butter is foamy but not brown, pour in the eggs.
Using a spatula, stir the eggs in a circular motion while shaking the pan for about 30 seconds.
When eggs are mostly set but still slightly wet on top, stop stirring and let cook undisturbed for 10 seconds.
Tilt the pan away from you and fold the omelette onto itself, rolling it onto a warm plate.
Brush with a little melted butter and serve immediately.

title: Sourdough Pancakes
description: Fluffy, tangy pancakes made with sourdough discard. Perfect lazy weekend breakfast.
ingredients: Butter and maple syrup for serving
steps: In a large bowl, whisk together sourdough discard, flour, and milk until smooth.
Add egg, melted butter, sugar, and vanilla; whisk until combined.
Just before cooking, sprinkle baking soda and salt over the batter and fold in gently — it will bubble.
Heat a griddle or large skillet over medium heat and lightly butter the surface.
Pour 1/4 cup batter per pancake and cook until bubbles form on the surface and edges look set, about 2-3 minutes.
Flip and cook another 1-2 minutes until golden.
Serve in a stack with butter and warm maple syrup.

title: Avocado Toast with Poached Egg
description: Crispy sourdough topped with creamy smashed avocado and a perfectly poached egg.
steps: Toast sourdough slices until golden and crispy.
Halve the avocado, remove the pit, and scoop flesh into a bowl. Mash roughly with a fork.
Season avocado with salt, a squeeze of lemon, and a drizzle of olive oil.
Bring a pot of water to a gentle simmer and add the vinegar.
Crack each egg into a small ramekin. Stir water to create a vortex and gently slip egg into the center.
Poach for 3-4 minutes until whites are set but yolks are runny. Remove with a slotted spoon.
Spread avocado on toast, top with poached egg, sprinkle with red pepper flakes, flaky salt, and microgreens.

title: Greek Yogurt Parfait
description: Layers of thick Greek yogurt, honey-roasted granola, and fresh seasonal berries.
ingredients: 1 cup mixed berries (blueberries, raspberries, sliced strawberries)
steps: In a small bowl, stir honey into the Greek yogurt until well combined.
In two glasses or bowls, layer 1/4 cup yogurt at the bottom.
Add a layer of granola, then a layer of berries.
Repeat layers until glasses are full, finishing with berries on top.
Sprinkle chia seeds over the top and garnish with fresh mint.
Serve immediately or refrigerate up to 2 hours before serving.

title: Shakshuka
description: Eggs poached in a spiced tomato-pepper sauce with cumin, paprika, and a touch of harissa.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add onion and bell pepper; cook until softened, about 8 minutes.
Add garlic, cumin, paprika, and cayenne; cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in crushed tomatoes and harissa. Simmer for 10-12 minutes until sauce thickens.
Make 6 small wells in the sauce. Crack an egg into each well.
Cover skillet and cook on low heat for 6-8 minutes until egg whites are set but yolks are runny.
Sprinkle with feta, cilantro, and parsley. Serve straight from the skillet with crusty bread.

title: Caesar Salad with Grilled Chicken
description: Crisp romaine, house-made Caesar dressing, shaved Parmigiano, and herb-grilled chicken breast.
steps: Season chicken breasts with olive oil, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper.
Grill over medium-high heat for 6-7 minutes per side until internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Let chicken rest for 5 minutes, then slice against the grain.
In a large bowl, toss romaine with Caesar dressing until evenly coated.
Add croutons and half the Parmigiano; toss gently.
Divide salad between plates, top with sliced chicken, and sprinkle remaining cheese.
Serve with lemon wedges.

title: Roasted Tomato Basil Soup
description: Slow-roasted Roma tomatoes blended with fresh basil and a touch of cream. Served with grilled cheese croutons.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F. Toss tomato halves and garlic cloves with 2 tbsp olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Spread on a baking sheet cut-side up. Roast for 35-40 minutes until caramelized.
Squeeze roasted garlic from skins. In a pot, heat remaining oil and sauté onion until translucent.
Add roasted tomatoes, garlic, and broth. Simmer for 10 minutes.
Remove from heat, add basil, and blend with an immersion blender until smooth.
Stir in cream and balsamic vinegar. Season to taste.
Serve hot topped with grilled cheese croutons and a drizzle of olive oil.

title: Mediterranean Quinoa Bowl
description: Fluffy quinoa with roasted vegetables, chickpeas, feta, and lemon-tahini dressing.
steps: Cook quinoa in water with a pinch of salt: bring to boil, reduce to simmer, cover for 15 minutes, then fluff.
Toss zucchini, bell pepper, and chickpeas with olive oil and oregano. Roast at 425°F for 20 minutes.
Whisk together tahini, lemon juice, 2 tbsp water, and a pinch of salt until smooth.
Assemble bowls: quinoa base, roasted vegetables and chickpeas, fresh tomatoes, olives, and feta.
Drizzle generously with tahini dressing and serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Banh Mi Sandwich
description: Vietnamese-style sandwich with lemongrass pork, pickled daikon and carrot, cucumber, and spicy mayo on a crusty baguette.
steps: Mix lemongrass, soy sauce, fish sauce, and honey. Marinate pork for at least 20 minutes.
Quick-pickle daikon and carrot: toss with rice vinegar, sugar, and a pinch of salt. Let sit 15 minutes.
Grill or pan-sear pork over high heat for 2-3 minutes per side until caramelized.
Split baguettes lengthwise, leaving a hinge. Spread sriracha mayo on both sides.
Layer pork, pickled vegetables, cucumber, cilantro, and jalapeño slices.
Close sandwich, press gently, and serve immediately.

title: Wild Mushroom Risotto
description: Creamy Arborio risotto with a medley of wild mushrooms, finished with Parmigiano and truffle oil.
ingredients: 1 lb mixed wild mushrooms (chanterelle, shiitake, oyster)
6 cups warm chicken or vegetable stock
steps: Clean mushrooms and slice. Sauté in 1 tbsp butter and olive oil over high heat until golden, about 5 minutes. Season and set aside.
In the same pot, add a little more oil and cook shallot until soft. Add garlic for 30 seconds.
Add rice and toast for 2 minutes, stirring constantly, until grains are translucent at edges.
Pour in wine and stir until absorbed.
Add warm stock one ladle at a time, stirring frequently and waiting until each addition is absorbed before adding the next.
After about 18-20 minutes, rice should be al dente and creamy.
Fold in mushrooms, remaining butter, Parmigiano, and thyme.
Serve immediately, drizzled with truffle oil and extra cheese.

title: Pan-Seared Salmon with Dill Sauce
description: Crispy-skinned Atlantic salmon fillet with a bright lemon-dill yogurt sauce and roasted asparagus.
steps: Pat salmon dry and score skin lightly. Season generously with salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Place salmon skin-side down and press gently for 10 seconds.
Cook 4-5 minutes without moving until skin is crispy. Flip and cook 2-3 more minutes for medium doneness.
Meanwhile, toss asparagus with olive oil, salt, and pepper. Roast at 425°F for 10-12 minutes.
Make sauce: mix yogurt, dill, lemon juice, zest, and garlic. Season with salt.
Plate salmon over asparagus and spoon dill sauce alongside.

title: Thai Green Curry
description: Aromatic green curry with chicken, bamboo shoots, Thai basil, and coconut milk, served over jasmine rice.
steps: Cook jasmine rice according to package directions.
Heat oil in a wok or large pot over medium-high heat. Fry green curry paste for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add half the coconut milk and simmer until oil separates, about 5 minutes.
Add chicken and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Pour in remaining coconut milk, bamboo shoots, bell pepper, and kaffir lime leaves.
Simmer for 12-15 minutes until chicken is cooked through and vegetables are tender.
Season with fish sauce and sugar. Stir in Thai basil just before serving.
Serve over jasmine rice.

title: Braised Short Ribs
description: Fork-tender beef short ribs braised in red wine and aromatics, served over creamy polenta.
steps: Season short ribs generously with salt and pepper. Sear in a hot Dutch oven with olive oil until deeply browned on all sides. Work in batches. Set aside.
Sauté onion, carrot, and celery in the same pot until softened, about 8 minutes. Add garlic and tomato paste; cook 2 minutes.
Deglaze with red wine, scraping up browned bits. Reduce by half.
Return ribs to the pot. Add stock, thyme, and bay leaves. Liquid should come 2/3 up the meat.
Cover and braise in a 325°F oven for 2.5-3 hours until meat pulls away from the bone.
Make polenta: bring salted water to boil, whisk in polenta, reduce heat and stir for 30 minutes. Finish with butter and Parmigiano.
Serve short ribs over polenta with some braising liquid spooned over top.

title: Tiramisu
description: Classic Italian dessert with espresso-soaked ladyfingers, mascarpone cream, and a dusting of cocoa.
steps: Whisk egg yolks and sugar until thick and pale, about 3 minutes.
Add mascarpone and beat until smooth.
In a separate bowl, whip heavy cream to stiff peaks. Fold into mascarpone mixture gently.
Combine espresso with coffee liqueur in a shallow dish.
Briefly dip ladyfingers into espresso (1 second per side — do not soak) and line the bottom of a 9x13 dish.
Spread half the mascarpone cream over the ladyfingers.
Repeat with another layer of dipped ladyfingers and remaining cream.
Dust the top generously with cocoa powder and chocolate shavings.
Refrigerate at least 6 hours, ideally overnight, before serving.

title: Lemon Ricotta Cheesecake
description: Light and creamy Italian-style cheesecake with bright lemon and ricotta on a buttery biscuit crust.
steps: Preheat oven to 325°F. Combine crushed biscuits and melted butter. Press into the bottom of a 9-inch springform pan.
Beat ricotta and cream cheese together until smooth.
Add sugar and beat until fluffy. Add eggs one at a time, mixing well after each.
Mix in lemon zest, lemon juice, vanilla, and flour until just combined.
Pour filling over crust and smooth the top.
Bake for 55-60 minutes until edges are set but center still has a slight wobble.
Turn off oven and leave cheesecake inside with door ajar for 1 hour.
Refrigerate at least 4 hours. Dust with powdered sugar before serving.

title: Dark Chocolate Lava Cake
description: Individual molten chocolate cakes with a gooey center. Deceptively simple and ready in under 30 minutes.
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F. Butter four 6-oz ramekins and dust with cocoa powder.
Melt chocolate and butter together in a double boiler or microwave, stirring until smooth. Let cool slightly.
Whisk eggs, egg yolks, and sugar until thick and light, about 2 minutes.
Fold chocolate mixture into egg mixture. Sift flour and salt over the top and fold gently.
Divide batter evenly among ramekins.
Bake for 12-14 minutes. The edges should be set and the center should jiggle slightly.
Let cool 1 minute, then run a knife around the edge and invert onto plates.
Serve immediately with vanilla ice cream.

title: Mango Sticky Rice
description: Classic Thai dessert with sweet glutinous rice, ripe mango, and warm coconut cream sauce.
steps: Soak glutinous rice in cold water for at least 4 hours or overnight. Drain.
Steam rice in a cheesecloth-lined steamer for 25-30 minutes until tender.
While rice steams, warm coconut milk, sugar, and salt (with pandan leaf if using) until sugar dissolves. Do not boil.
Transfer hot steamed rice to a bowl and pour most of the coconut mixture over it. Stir gently and let rest 15 minutes to absorb.
Reserve a few tablespoons of coconut sauce for drizzling.
Mound sticky rice on plates, arrange mango slices alongside, and drizzle with reserved coconut sauce.
Sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds and serve at room temperature.

title: Classic Margherita Pizza
description: Neapolitan-style pizza with San Marzano tomato sauce, fresh mozzarella, and basil on a chewy, charred crust.
steps: Mix flour, yeast, and salt. Add water and olive oil; knead for 8-10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Let dough rise in a covered bowl for 1.5 hours until doubled.
Preheat oven to 500°F with a pizza stone or inverted baking sheet inside for at least 30 minutes.
Divide dough in half and stretch each into a 10-inch round on a floured surface.
Spread crushed tomatoes on each round, leaving a 1-inch border. Top with mozzarella slices.
Slide onto the hot stone and bake for 8-10 minutes until crust is charred and cheese is bubbling.
Remove, top with fresh basil, drizzle with olive oil, and sprinkle with flaky salt.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
description: Tandoori-marinated chicken pieces in a rich, spiced tomato-cream sauce. Serve with naan and basmati rice.
ingredients: Naan and basmati rice for serving
steps: Mix yogurt, tandoori masala, and ginger-garlic paste. Add chicken and marinate at least 30 minutes.
Thread chicken onto skewers and broil (or grill) for 12-15 minutes, turning once, until charred at edges.
Heat ghee in a large pan. Sauté onion until golden, about 10 minutes.
Add garam masala, turmeric, cumin, and paprika. Cook 1 minute.
Pour in crushed tomatoes and simmer for 15 minutes until thickened.
Add cream and simmer 5 minutes. Fold in the broiled chicken pieces.
Simmer 5 more minutes. Garnish with cilantro and serve with warm naan and rice.

title: Berry Pavlova
description: A showstopping meringue shell with a marshmallow-soft center, topped with whipped cream and fresh summer berries.
ingredients: 3 cups mixed berries (raspberries, blueberries, blackberries, sliced strawberries)
steps: Preheat oven to 250°F. Line a baking sheet with parchment and draw a 9-inch circle as a guide.
Beat egg whites until soft peaks form. Gradually add sugar, 1 tbsp at a time, beating until stiff and glossy.
Fold in vinegar, cornstarch, and vanilla gently.
Spoon meringue onto the parchment circle, building up the edges to create a well.
Bake for 1 hour 15 minutes. Turn off oven, leave door slightly open, and let cool completely inside.
Whip cream with powdered sugar until soft peaks.
Fill the cooled meringue with whipped cream and pile berries on top.
Drizzle with passion fruit pulp if using, garnish with mint, and serve immediately.

title: Butternut Squash Soup
description: Velvety roasted butternut squash soup with sage brown butter and toasted pumpkin seeds.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F. Toss squash cubes with olive oil, salt, and pepper. Roast for 35 minutes until tender and caramelized.
In a pot, sauté onion in olive oil until soft. Add garlic for 30 seconds.
Add roasted squash and broth. Simmer for 10 minutes.
Blend until smooth with an immersion blender. Stir in cream and a pinch of nutmeg.
Make sage brown butter: melt butter in a small pan until it turns golden and nutty. Add sage leaves and fry until crisp.
Toast pumpkin seeds in a dry pan until they pop.
Serve soup drizzled with sage butter and sprinkled with pumpkin seeds.

title: Pad Thai
description: Classic Thai stir-fried rice noodles with shrimp, tofu, bean sprouts, peanuts, and tamarind sauce.
steps: Soak rice noodles in warm water for 20 minutes until pliable. Drain.
Mix tamarind paste, fish sauce, sugar, and rice vinegar for the sauce.
Heat oil in a wok over high heat. Fry tofu until golden. Add shrimp and cook until pink. Set aside.
Add more oil, crack eggs into the wok and scramble.
Add drained noodles and sauce. Toss everything together for 2 minutes.
Return shrimp and tofu, add bean sprouts and green onions. Toss for 1 more minute.
Serve garnished with crushed peanuts, extra bean sprouts, lime wedges, and chili flakes.

title: Blueberry Dutch Baby
description: A puffy, oven-baked pancake with bursting blueberries and a dusting of powdered sugar. Dramatic and easy.
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F. Place a 10-inch cast iron skillet inside to heat.
Blend eggs, flour, milk, sugar, vanilla, and salt until smooth. Let batter rest 5 minutes.
Carefully remove hot skillet, add butter and swirl to melt and coat the pan.
Pour batter into the hot skillet. Scatter blueberries evenly over the top.
Bake for 18-20 minutes until puffed and deeply golden at the edges.
Remove, dust with powdered sugar and lemon zest. Slice and serve immediately with maple syrup.

title: Falafel Wrap
description: Crispy baked chickpea falafel in warm pita with tahini sauce, pickled turnips, and fresh herb salad.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F. Pulse chickpeas, onion, garlic, herbs, and spices in a food processor until coarse (not puréed).
Transfer to a bowl, fold in baking powder and flour. Shape into 16 small patties.
Brush with olive oil and bake on a lined sheet for 20-25 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and crisp.
Warm pita breads. Spread tahini sauce inside each.
Add falafel, pickled turnips, sliced tomato, cucumber, and lettuce.
Wrap tightly and serve with extra tahini on the side.
